messages:
Marc (Hiring): Heads up team — Omar (cc'd) accepted the offer and plans to enter on a TN at the Blaine crossing. Wants to start Mon Jun 7. Can we do a POE start? Any special HR/payroll steps?
Emily (People Ops): POE starts OK but we need to coordinate I-9 verification within 3 business days and ensure benefits/tax setup. Key items: signed employer support letter, copy of offer, payroll enrollment forms, and a local verifier. Also flag payroll cutoff dates.
Omar (Candidate): Yep Ill aim for crossing late afternoon Jun 6 and present TN docs. I can bring passport + letters. Do I need anything else at the border?
Priya (Immigration Counsel): We'll prepare a support letter on Redwood letterhead outlining role, salary, and contact details. TN is usually straightforward for Canadian citizens in eligible occupations. CBP might ask for additional evidence of non-immigrant intent or detailed job duties. If they ask for counsel, give them our number. Contingency: if denied, candidate cannot work until status resolved; plan for delayed onboarding or remote unpaid orientation only.
Alex (Payroll): Operational notes: we need physical I-9 inspection within 3 business days after the start date. If the verifier signs on Jun 7we can include Omar in payroll if all tax & bank info are submitted by the payroll cutoff (5 days before pay date). If not, we might need to process a retro paycheck. Also confirm his W-4 and direct deposit before first run.
Nina (Recruiter): Omar, can you confirm planned CBP crossing time and port? We'll schedule an authorized I-9 verifier nearby (Blaine or Bellingham) for an in-person check. If you prefer, we can authorize a notary we partner with.
Omar (Candidate): Blaine, afternoon Jun 6 (~3:30pm). Notary would be easier if available that evening.
Emily (People Ops): Plan suggestion: 1) We email signed support letter and offer PDF to you and provide a succinct one-page duties summary (CBP sometimes asks). 2) You present docs at POE and request admission under TN for Software Engineer. 3) Within 3 business days of your start, meet with our verifier for I-9 physical review (we can do evening Jun 6 if not done at the office). 4) Benefits portal opens on hire date; coverage effective per plan rules once on payroll.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Draft support letter below; we'll put on letterhead and sign. Please review and confirm job title and SOC entry.

```
To: U.S. Customs and Border Protection
Re: Omar Rahman  TN Admission Request

Dear Officer,

This letter confirms that Redwood Inference is offering Omar Rahman the position of Software Engineer (full-time) with an annual salary of $142,000 USD. The position involves systems design, coding, and maintenance of inference platform components.

Employer contact: Marc Lee, marc@redwood.com, +1-415-555-0199
Immigration counsel: Priya Rao, priya@lawco.com, +1-206-555-0123

We request inspection and admission for TN classification for temporary entry. If additional verification is required, please contact our counsel.
```

Nina (Recruiter): We'll DM the verifier contact and confirm whether they can meet Jun 6 evening at Blaine POE parking area. Also will attach signed letter & duties summary to this thread once signed.
Alex (Payroll): Omar please upload bank routing and W-4 by Jun 2 to hit payroll cutoff. If you can't, allow for retro pay processing.
Omar (Candidate): Uploaded my bank and tax forms now. Thanks.
Emily (People Ops): Noted receipt. @Priya can you include the counsel phone in the final PDF? Also add one-line about expected duration (ongoing) to reduce CBP follow-ups.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Will include duration and counsel phone, and send signed PDF by EOD today.
imm-legal-bot: Reminder set: add TN entry case note to candidate file and create 48-hour start checklist. :white_check_mark:
Marc (Hiring): Great. Appreciate the thoroughness. Omar, welcome aboard  see you soon. :tada:
